svg.title: About TakaJun02
svg.desc: About: Graduate student at Akita Prefectural University. Software engineer focused on LLMs, AI agents, and RAG. Hands-on industry experience building RAG-powered AI agents. Exploring agent architecture: tool calling, sub-agents, context management, human-in-the-loop. A map of Japan in ASCII marks Akita. Tech stack: ai / llm: LangGraph, LangChain, Claude API, OpenAI API, Ollama, vLLM, RAG; languages: Python, TypeScript, JavaScript; backend / frontend: FastAPI, Vue.js; databases: PostgreSQL, SQLite, ChromaDB, Qdrant; infrastructure / tools: Docker, AWS, Git, GitHub, Linux, Claude Code, Codex.
